Cambium Networks XV2-21X Wi-Fi 6 Indoor Enterprise Wireless Access Point

The Cambium XV2-21X Wi-Fi 6 Indoor Enterprise Wireless Access Point is a high-performance solution designed for reliable, fast, and secure indoor wireless connectivity. Powered by the latest Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, this access point delivers improved throughput, reduced latency, and enhanced stability in high-density environments. Whether you’re deploying Wi-Fi in an office, school, hotel, retail store, or enterprise building, the XV2-21X ensures seamless coverage and exceptional user experience.

Equipped with 2×2 MU-MIMO, dual-band radios, Gigabit uplink, and advanced WPA3 enterprise-grade security, this AP is built for modern networks with increasing device loads. It supports PoE power, flexible ceiling/wall mounting, and centralized cloud management through Cambium cnMaestro, making deployment and monitoring easier than ever.

For organizations in Bangladesh looking for reliable enterprise Wi-Fi, the Cambium XV2-21X provides the perfect balance of performance, cost-efficiency, and long-term stability. Get the best price and 100% genuine products at OTECH BD.


Key Features

  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) dual-band enterprise access point
  • 2×2 MU-MIMO for improved speed and user capacity
  • Up to 2.97 Gbps aggregate throughput
  • Dual-radio operation: 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz
  • Gigabit Ethernet uplink port (10/100/1000 Mbps)
  • Internal high-gain antennas for strong indoor coverage
  • Supports WPA3-SAE & WPA3-Enterprise security
  • Manageable via Cambium cnMaestro Cloud/On-Premise
  • PoE (802.3af/at) support for easy installation
  • Ideal for offices, schools, hotels, retail, SMEs & enterprise networks
  • Includes ceiling/wall mounting kit
